effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 green or blue card with [Dramon] in its name and 1 card with [Examon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Dramon] or [Examon] in its name becomes suspended, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
